analysis:
Examined both BASE excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (802–1610) and the bounded change map/patch. The visible change at HEAD 810–813 expands GLM video admission to variable-frame-rate tracks, sampled by frame index divided by nominalFrameRate; HEAD 829 removes their deterministic rejection. This broadens adversarial consumer media input at TB-007, but the documentation alone establishes no exploitable regression. The surrounding contract retains decoded/prepared-pixel caps, vision reservations, target-only media execution and exclusion from prefix reuse (BASE 812–833), relevant to A-001, T-028, T-041 and availability. Reviewed surrounding prompt-cache account scoping, receipt-based billing, cancellation/retirement ownership, warmup limits, deadline qualification and MTP output-budget controls; these portions are unchanged by the complete range map and are not new findings. No visible change affects attestation, serving authorization, credentials, hop encryption or privileged fan authority.
Integration must inspect GLM5NextProcessor.decodeAsset and GLM5NextVisionBudget.mediaReservation/videoTokenCeiling: verify finite positive frame-rate validation and that VFR frame indexing, sample count, actual decode work and reservation ceilings agree, including malformed tracks and cancellation. This is an unverified implementation contract, not evidence of a missing control. HEAD additions at 876–880 and 1717–1726 are listed but their contents are not supplied in these units; they require review in the other source passes. No full implementation or PR-wide security conclusion is possible from these BASE documentation excerpts.
